answer_1.quote: We investigate the harness of internal knowledge for reasoning through the lens of Knowledge Neurons (KNs). We focus on the basic setting of factual reasoning involving the composition of two facts (for example, "Who is the chairperson of the manufacturer of Holden Caprice?" in Figure ).
answer_1.outputs: natural language responses to two-hop factual questions

answer_2.quote: We assess the level of factual recall at each reasoning step by introducing a novel metric, KN Scores.
